html:
The Ngadjuri are an Aboriginal Australian people of the mid north of South Australia. Their lands ran from Gawler in the south to Orroroo in the Flinders Ranges in the north. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Their country is rolling hills and plains between the coast and the dry interior. After the colony of South Australia was founded in 1836, sheep runs, wheat farms and copper mines spread north into Ngadjuri land within a few years. Neighbours on the map include the Kaurna, the Nukunu and the Peramangk. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
